0.original: <hex:024804F201FC03><hex:024904F201FD03> Quest Sync<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>Harvene is dreading her next journey into the woods.

25.original: Deliver the peeling bark to Harvene.

48.original: Ah, you are one of Master Matoya's guests, are you not? Perhaps you can assist me.

49.original: To the west of here, in Lake Tusi Mek'ta, sits a tree which cradles an enormous crystal─Fruit of the Protector. It is said to have existed even before the empire of Ronka.

50.original: I require the bark from this tree and I would ask you to retrieve it for me.

51.original: I must make dye for our clothes, you see, and it is a most vital ingredient.

52.original: As you might expect, eaters and all manner of beasts are drawn to its power. Were the woods not so rife with danger I would go myself.

53.original: Please say you will help. I require but four pieces of bark to finish my work.

54.original: Do be careful when peeling the bark, lest you damage the tree.

55.original: Ah, you are returned. Were you able to reach the tree?

56.original: Thank you, <hex:02080EE905FF056D697373FF0473697203>, thank you! I realize it looks like ordinary bark at a glance, but it makes for such wondrous colors when properly ground and mixed.

57.original: Garments dyed using the bark from that tree are said to be blessed by the Protector, you know.

58.original: Mark my words: every guard in Slitherbough will be dressed from head to toe in clothes using my dye. Perhaps even the children and the elderly!

59.original: I better set to boiling this bark. If you'll excuse me.
